newsitem.title: CHINA: ADB has lent $5.8 billion to China since 1986.
newsitem.headline: ADB has lent $5.8 billion to China since 1986.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) had extended a total of $5.8 billion in loans to China as of September, the official media said on Wednesday.
It said the total was calculated from 1986, when China joined the international organisation.
The Financial Daily said the funds were used for 54 different projects, most of them to build power stations, expressways and railways.
The ADB has offered China about $95 million in technical aid and about $426 million in syndicated loans, the official media said.
